book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iudaꞌa Iesu Revohatihi Reiro
Isiti Oꞌoꞌa ꞌUvauḡa Odoga Muiḡa, niḡa ꞌahogaꞌe Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa madaḡaniꞌa hanitiro.
Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa Iesu matiteꞌe ibiḡa nu vaḡiro, mazaḡa ze vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa maḡuniꞌuma radu rihoziro.
Isakariota vazeḡa, niḡa Iudaꞌe Iesu tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare boꞌaḡano tahiꞌa ꞌahoga. Sataniꞌa ane zama diuḡiro.
Aniꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu kuru neḡa uti vazeḡa boroboro vaḡe onamadu zeḡe ꞌevoreo Iesu riꞌiniteꞌe ibiḡa ḡoꞌane vaḡiro.
Ze matuꞌe rudanadu Iuda hadi haꞌuma rae ḡoitoriro.
Iudaꞌa zuni, “Idaḡa,” radu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa oꞌoꞌa madaḡano Iesu riꞌinoga veize mada manoḡa ꞌahoga vaḡiro.
Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa Ruhibe Tiro
Isiti Oꞌoꞌa ꞌUvahuḡa Odoga Muiḡa zamaḡano mada ibiꞌaꞌe Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa. Eꞌe madaḡano dibuꞌo mamoeḡa ubuga maro.
Eꞌe madaḡa meirotene, Iesuꞌa Petero zu Ioane tuḡuzeꞌenaꞌa, ziro, “Onamadu emeḡe veize Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ogomuḡa ruhibe toꞌi.”
Ebu zeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Ḡa urao eme nouma ruhibe tiꞌuma?”
Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Ne boro diuḡine, ohoze ꞌahoganiꞌa vu ḡoḡoreḡa odohe onameꞌeteꞌe horoniꞌuma. Ebu ani hegotadu aneꞌa diuḡeꞌeteꞌe neḡa diuḡoꞌi.
Diuḡadu eꞌe ne vazeḡa noꞌi, 'Ihore vazeḡaniꞌa ꞌahige raꞌohe: E eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ogomuḡa atihi. Iꞌudo azaḡa veize ruhibiroteꞌe habaꞌaꞌe noumao?'
ꞌOugine, aniꞌa ne hitagano bazuni neḡa boro ꞌahoga ihoziꞌuma, zu zaꞌe ehoro habaꞌa ruhibe teateꞌe horoniꞌuma. Eꞌea ogomufe ruhibe toꞌi.”
Ze iḡunadu onamiro, ebu Iesuꞌa ziroteꞌe idunane niduꞌa horoniro. ꞌOugadu Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ruhibe tiro.
Ḡonaga Ogomuḡa Aro
Madaḡaniꞌa feurirotene, Iesu apostolo azaḡa teite ogomu fataḡa uhiḡano ehoriro.
Ebu aniꞌa ziro, “E ꞌizema aduga hidogano, zae teite Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ogomuḡa ꞌadi anoga hube hune uratiro.
Mazaḡa eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, eꞌe Mui ogomuḡa ꞌahiꞌe mene bare aꞌuma, onamo Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡano Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡaniꞌa hugano fureraꞌuma.”
Ebu aniꞌa vaini vuḡa bioḡa madu Badiꞌa mazao kuraro ebu ziro, “Bio ꞌahi madu zaꞌe tahitahe gagoꞌi.
Mazaḡa eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, eꞌe vaini vuḡa mene bare gagiꞌuma, onamo Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariꞌuma.”
Ebu ani ꞌuvahu odoga meiro zu Badiꞌa mazao kuranadu vahege ziniro, ebu ziro, “ꞌUvahu odoga ꞌahiꞌe zae veize moditeꞌe ahirihe. Zaeꞌa eḡe zamarifine iḡaiḡa ꞌahi haḡaoꞌi.”
Ebu ḡorava ogomuḡa enogano ani vaini vuḡa bioḡa madu ziro, “Vaini vuḡa bioḡa ꞌahiꞌe eḡeꞌa zae veize beꞌuneꞌeteꞌe ruhe hina ohoneꞌeteꞌe ḡoitoreḡa iziga.
Rehano eḡe revoniteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe teite ogau tiburuꞌohe.
Vaze Ubugaꞌe Badiꞌa urao rudaꞌuma. Rehano ani revohatiteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma.”
ꞌOugadu ze zeḡeꞌa bare ḡadimutitiro, “Emeḡe boꞌaḡano iniuꞌa ꞌougiꞌuma?”
Iniuꞌe Niḡa Boro?
Ebu Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌa boꞌaḡano iniuꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune radu ze zeḡeꞌa bare taꞌirotitiro.
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa azaḡa habaꞌano kini niduꞌaꞌe zeḡe haba azaḡa riḡa zuhiꞌaziꞌohe. Ebu inaraze hina zeḡe haba azaḡa rana edauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare 'Duꞌu Vazeḡa' rae huzeꞌohe.
Rehano za ze ago teigoꞌi. Zae boꞌaḡano vaze ḡihiꞌaḡa huneꞌe tahiꞌa komeꞌa teigiꞌuma, ebu iniu zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa teigiꞌuma.
Iniuꞌe ufeta ḡihiꞌaḡa? Ehore ogauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ga tuḡure vazeḡa? Aꞌe ehore ogauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa. Rehano eꞌe zae boꞌaḡano tuḡure vazeḡa heuḡa.
Zaꞌe eḡeꞌa aduga hidiroteꞌe zamaḡano eḡe teite radiroteꞌe azaḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo eḡe Mamaꞌa ḡau niduꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe gigiꞌaḡa iniroteꞌe teige, eḡeꞌa zae zuni eꞌe gigiꞌaḡa ziniꞌohe.
Ebu zaꞌe eḡeꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano eḡe teite ogaꞌuma zu gagiꞌuma, ebu kini ehoro habaꞌano ehoradu Isaraela azaḡa, urabo niduꞌa gaubanana aheu fare kotaziꞌuma.”
Peteroꞌa Iesu Oꞌoniꞌuma rae Ihoziro
Ebu Iesuꞌa Simona niro, “Simona, Simona, ꞌadi egoꞌi. Sataniꞌa vuidi zuizuineꞌeteꞌe
teige, zae zama tuhunoga veize Badiꞌa uminiro.
Rehano ḡaeꞌa eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌeꞌa mene dauḡifine, e ḡae veize kuraro. Eꞌanoꞌo ḡaeꞌa ḡihuradu eḡe vaḡe bariteꞌe madaḡano negoḡo duḡuru inarazoꞌi.”
Peteroꞌa naenaeniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eꞌe ḡae teite ḡuꞌa neḡano diuḡiꞌuma, ebu ḡae teite rudaꞌuma zuni idaḡa!”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Petero, eḡeꞌa ḡaꞌohe, izidi ohere kokorokuꞌa ꞌizema uganogano, ḡaeꞌa ḡae uḡidu oꞌoheꞌenaꞌa, e aḡuꞌa rae reꞌuma.”
Hadi Fuseḡa, Nihara zu Benisi

Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro, “Zaeꞌa eḡe gau haḡaoga veize tuḡuziroteꞌe madaḡano zaꞌe hadi fuseḡa, nihara ebu tamaka mene odohe onamiro. Eꞌe madaḡano ḡau ꞌahoga ferezirohe?” Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Mene.”
Aniꞌa ziro, “Izidi zaꞌe hadi fusezeta zu niharazeta roꞌidene, eꞌe moꞌi. Ebu zaꞌe benisize oꞌoꞌa roꞌidene, dabuaze seronadu eꞌe hoitoꞌi.
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, 'Vazevazeꞌa aniꞌe ḡonore azaḡa boꞌaḡano ꞌahoga rae zamariꞌuma.' Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, eꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa eḡe mazao hudaꞌuma. Hube hune eḡe moneo mirihiroteꞌeꞌa izidi hudauꞌohe.”
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, emeḡe mazaoꞌe benisi aheu.” Iesuꞌa ziro, “Ahiḡa.”
Iesuꞌa Olivi Maḡano Kuraro
Ebu Iesuꞌe iḡaiḡa haḡainuteꞌe teige, Olivi Maḡa onamiro zu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ane hegotiro.
Aniꞌa eꞌe habaꞌano feuradu ziro, “Sataniꞌa tuhuzadu zaeꞌa mene uitifine kuranoꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ze modadu tahiḡa mobade onamiro ebu obena hina tuḡadu kuraro,
“Mama, ḡa uratoꞌidene, eḡe mazaonoꞌo bio aduga ꞌadi mae vaḡinoꞌi. Rehano eḡe mene urao, ḡae urao daꞌo haḡaoꞌi.”
Eꞌe madaḡano tuḡure viga ꞌahoganiꞌa adureonoꞌo ane vaḡe ovadu inaraharo.
Ani zamaḡa ufeta adudanadu zamaḡa niduꞌa hina ufeta inare kuraro. Eꞌanoꞌo irairaḡaniꞌa ru teige rahao sore buaro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa kuru hauḡadu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa vaḡe bare onamirotene ze bazeꞌeteꞌe horoziro, mazaḡa zamaze ufeta aradu ahirizeꞌa taoraro.
Eꞌanoꞌo aniꞌa ziro, “Za nougadu baze radiuꞌohe? Iḡunoꞌi, ebu Sataniꞌa tuhuzadu zaeꞌa mene uitifine kuranoꞌi.”
Iesu Obone Tiro
Iesuꞌa ꞌize ḡoereꞌeteꞌea, vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa ani vaḡe ariro. Ebu Iesu tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare boꞌaḡano ꞌahoga, Iudaꞌa ibitadu Iesu furaꞌinoga veize ani uhiḡa ariro.
Rehano Iesuꞌa niro, “Iuda, ḡaꞌe Vaze Ubuga furaꞌinadu revohatihi raꞌehe?”
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe naginiꞌa fureruꞌeteꞌe horonadu Iesu niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eme benisi hina utitoziniꞌumahe?”
Ebu zeḡe boꞌaḡano ꞌahoganiꞌa benisi ahase bunadu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa tuḡure vazeḡa udirotene, edaꞌe teḡaḡa variꞌe butiro.
Rehano Iesuꞌa niro, “Ago ꞌougoꞌi!” Ebu Iesuꞌa vaze eꞌe teḡa obonadu fainiro.

Ebu Iesuꞌa ani obone touga veize ariroteꞌe dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa, kuru neḡa vazeḡa boroboro zu vaze boroboro ziro, “Zaꞌe ḡonore vazeḡa obone tiꞌeteꞌe teige, benisi ebu somori boro madu eḡe obohe touga veize arahe?
Mada niduꞌa eꞌe zae teite kuru neḡa habaꞌano radiunu. Eꞌe madaḡano zaꞌe mene obohe tiro. Rehano izidiꞌe zae madaḡa zu uzaboꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡa.”
Peteroꞌa Iesu Oꞌoniro
Zeꞌa Iesu obone teadu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa ne tutune onamiro. U Peteroꞌe faḡanonoꞌo zeḡe ḡaruna hegotiro.
Vaze nuꞌa eꞌe ne habaꞌa nemaḡano ire roga hofadu ehore ḡeḡemaḡiro. Petero zuni zeḡe teite ehoriro.
ꞌOugirotene, tuḡure roḡaeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa Peteroꞌe ire roga genaḡano ehoreꞌeteꞌe horoniro. Ani Petero ḡiane runeꞌenaꞌa reiro, “Vaze ꞌadi zuni Iesu teite radiudo.”
Rehano Peteroꞌa oꞌonadu niro, “Roḡae, e ani aḡua.”
Mada tahiḡa enogano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa horonadu niro, “Ḡa zuni Iesu hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano ꞌahoga.” Rehano Peteroꞌa niro, “Ohoze, eꞌe mene!”
Mada tahiḡa ḡarugano, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa barebare ḡoeriro, “Vaze ꞌadi hube hune Iesu teite radiudo, mazaḡa ani zuni Galilea vazeḡa.”
Rehano Peteroꞌa naenaeniro, “Ohoze, e ḡaꞌa nagini raꞌetaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa!” Peteroꞌa ꞌize ḡoereꞌeteꞌea, kokorokuꞌa ugaro.
Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa vaetadu Petero ḡianiro. ꞌOugadu Peteroꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa ꞌahige rae niroteꞌe zamariro, “Izidi ohere kokorokuꞌa ꞌizema uganogano, ḡaꞌa ḡae uḡidu eḡe oꞌohiꞌuma.”
Ebu aniꞌa ne enona buanadu niau rudaro.
Uti Azaḡaniꞌa Iesu rae Sausauniro zu Masiniro
Iesu ḡiane radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ani ḡirihoharo zu bouniro.
Ze ani ubuma ꞌuadu ḡadiniro, “Peroveta vazeḡa, iniuꞌa ḡa bouꞌeha? Efoꞌi.”
Ebu ze ḡoere nunu hina ani rae sausauniro.
Iesu Kotao Ohoniro
Irarirotene, dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa nuꞌoranadu vaze boroboroꞌa ibitohauꞌeteꞌe kotaḡano ḡoꞌaniro. Ebu Iesuꞌe zeḡe kotao tutune mae ohoniro.
Ebu zeꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌe Keriso roꞌidene, efoꞌi.” Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡeꞌa, 'Oꞌe,' rae zine zuni, zaꞌe eḡe ḡoere mene mae ḡihiniꞌuma.
Ebu eḡeꞌa, 'E Kerisohe?' rae ḡadizine zuni, zaꞌe mene naenaehiꞌuma.
Rehano izidionoꞌo onamo zama mone Vaze Ubuganiꞌa Gigiꞌaḡa Boro Badiꞌaḡa edaꞌe moneo ehoriꞌuma.”
Zeḡe niduꞌa ḡadiniro, “Tena ḡaꞌe Badiꞌa Ubugahe?” Aniꞌa ziro, “Za zaeꞌa bare eꞌe Keriso rae raꞌohe.”
Ebu ze zeḡeꞌa bare neneḡaniro, “Eme aniꞌe veꞌoḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa bare vaḡiꞌumahe? Emeḡeꞌa ane hebeonoꞌo ḡoere veꞌoḡa rateꞌe egeha!”

footnotes.text: Vuidi hiriveꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano vuidi zuizuinine, hugaꞌe zamaḡano radiuꞌohe ebu ogaḡaꞌe rururuꞌohe.
